claims.source: Indeed, the cells continued to grow and divide (Figure 2—figure supplement 1B), and after an initial slow start, the nigericin-treated cells recover their doubling rate within 24 hr (Figure 2—figure supplement 1C).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by cell growth assay data.

claims.claim: Short nigericin treatment induces reversible changes and has minimal impact on cell health.
claims.source: In line with previous reports (Merion and Sly, 1983; Vladutiu, 1984), our findings indicate that short nigericin treatment induces reversible changes and has minimal impact on cell health.
claims.evidence: This conclusion is based on cell growth data and is consistent with previous research.

claims.claim: A portion of GalT-GFP entered the endosomal pathway even in cells without nigericin treatment.
claims.source: Even in cells without nigericin treatment, a portion of GalT-GFP entered the endosomal pathway, as it was present in Rab5 positive vesicles (Figure 3A).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on fluorescence microscopy observations in untreated cells.

claims.claim: Following nigericin treatment, Golgi vesiculation was observed within 15 min of nigericin washout.
claims.source: Following nigericin treatment, Golgi vesiculation was observed within 15 min of nigericin washout (Figure 3B, Figure 3—video 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by time-lapse imaging data.

claims.claim: A large fraction of Golgi-derived vesicles adopted early endosomal identity because individual GalT-positive structures acquired Rab5 over time.
claims.source: A large fraction of these vesicles would adopt early endosomal identity because individual GalT-positive structures acquired Rab5 over time (Figure 3B), as also observed by immuno-electron microscopy (Figure 3C).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by fluorescence and electron microscopy data.

claims.claim: Endogenous GalT persisted in the endosomes.
claims.source: Moreover, similar to the transiently transfected GalT-GFP, endogenous GalT persisted in the endosomes (Figure 3D), consistent with the observations of its subsequent internalisation into ILVs (Figure 2B and 11D), and Golgi morphology was fully recovered within 48 hr (Figure 2—figure supplement 1E).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by immunofluorescence data showing endogenous GalT in endosomes.

claims.claim: Endocytic cargo contributes to the enlarged compartments, as evidenced by Dextran-AF488 detection in Rab5-positive enlarged endosomes.
claims.source: The contribution of cargo from the endocytic pathway to the enlarged compartments was evidenced by the addition of Dextran-AF488 for 20 min to the cell medium of nigericin-treated cells and its detection in the Rab5-positive enlarged endosomes already within 8 min of Dextran-AF488 washout (Figure 3—figure supplement 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by imaging data showing Dextran uptake into enlarged endosomes.

claims.claim: Rab5-positive, Dextran-containing endosomes can undergo Rab conversion and acquire Rab7, retaining the Dextran as they mature to endolysosomes.
claims.source: These Rab5-positive, Dextran-containing endosomes can also undergo Rab conversion and acquire Rab7, retaining the Dextran as they mature to endolysosomes (Figure 3—figure supplement 1B).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by time-lapse imaging data.

claims.claim: Surface Transferrin receptor (TfR-GFP) labeled with mCherry-tagged anti-GFP nanobody could reach BFP-Rab5 positive enlarged endosomes.
claims.source: Moreover, to demonstrate that the enlarged Rab5-positive endosomes can also acquire plasma membrane cargo, we labeled surface Transferrin receptor (TfR-GFP) with mCherry-tagged anti-GFP nanobody and found that it could reach BFP-Rab5 positive enlarged endosomes (Figure 3—figure supplement 2).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by imaging data showing TfR uptake into enlarged endosomes.

claims.claim: Acute nigericin treatment leads to enlarged Golgi-derived compartments that are able to acquire early endosomal identity, take up endocytic cargo and mature into late endosomes.
claims.source: Taken together, our findings suggest that acute nigericin treatment leads to enlarged Golgi-derived compartments that are able to acquire early endosomal identity, take up endocytic cargo and mature into late endosomes.
claims.evidence: This is a summary conclusion based on multiple experimental observations.

claims.claim: Rab conversion was completed within 4 min after its initiation.
claims.source: Moreover, Rab conversion was completed within 4 min after its initiation, which is similar to previously reported observations (Del Conte-Zerial et al., 2008; Poteryaev et al., 2010; Rink et al., 2005).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of time-lapse imaging data and is consistent with previous research.

claims.claim: Rab5 levels dropped when Rab7 reached about 50% of its maximal level.
claims.source: Consistent with previous findings, Rab5 levels dropped when Rab7 reached about 50 % of its maximal level (Figure 4B–D; Del Conte-Zerial et al., 2008; Poteryaev et al., 2010; van der Schaar et al., 2008).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by quantitative analysis of fluorescence intensity data and is consistent with previous research.

claims.claim: Once Rab5 was fully removed, Rab7 plateaued off showing stable presence at the late endosome.
claims.source: Once Rab5 was fully removed, Rab7 plateaued off showing stable presence at the late endosome (Figure 4D; Figure 4—figure supplement 1B).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of time-lapse imaging data.

claims.claim: Occasionally, Rab5 produced multiple peaks, with Rab7 plateauing off after the latest Rab5 peak.
claims.source: Occasionally, Rab5 produced multiple peaks, with Rab7 plateauing off after the latest Rab5 peak (Figure 4—figure supplement 1C and D).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on observations from individual endosome tracking.

claims.claim: Multiple Rab5 peaks may indicate the reversible nature of endosome maturation and existence of checkpoints to ensure alignment of parallel processes.
claims.source: Such Rab5 behavior may indicate the reversible nature of endosome maturation and existence of checkpoints to ensure alignment of parallel processes.
claims.evidence: This is a speculative interpretation of the observed Rab5 behavior.

claims.claim: Rab5 and GFP-FYVE appeared concomitantly on enlarged early endosomes.
claims.source: As expected, Rab5 and GFP-FYVE appeared concomitantly on enlarged early endosomes (Figure 5; Figure 5—video 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by time-lapse imaging data showing co-recruitment of Rab5 and PI(3)P marker.

claims.claim: After Rab5 peaked, there was a slight delay in the disappearance of GFP-FYVE.
claims.source: However, after Rab5 peaked, we observed a slight delay in the disappearance of GFP-FYVE (Figure 5B and C; Figure 5—figure supplement 1), suggesting that the onset of PI(3)P conversion to either PI or PI(3,5)P2 occurs with some delay.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of fluorescence intensity data.

claims.claim: PI(3)P levels on endosomes are tightly regulated temporally and spatially during maturation.
claims.source: Nevertheless, our data are consistent with a tight temporal and spatial regulation of PI(3)P levels on endosomes during maturation.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed kinetics of PI(3)P marker.

claims.claim: The nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes are capable of ILV formation and internalisation of the GalT marker.
claims.source: Our electron microscopy data provides evidence that the nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes are capable of ILV formation and internalisation of the GalT marker (Figure 2B).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by electron microscopy data.

claims.claim: The presence of Snx1-GFP in transient punctate microdomains or tubular protrusions at the enlarged endosomes suggests active sorting from the endosome to the plasma membrane and the Golgi.
claims.source: Additionally, the presence of Snx1-GFP in transient punctate microdomains or tubular protrusions at the enlarged endosomes suggests active sorting from the endosome to the plasma membrane and the Golgi (Figure 6A).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the known function of Snx1 and its observed localization.

claims.claim: Snx1 assembly on endosomes occurred concomitantly with Rab5 recruitment.
claims.source: Snx1 assembly on endosomes occurred concomitantly with Rab5 recruitment (Figure 6A–C; Figure 6—video 1; Figure 6—figure supplement 1 A and B), pointing to a potential coordination.
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by time-lapse imaging data showing co-recruitment of Snx1 and Rab5.

claims.claim: Snx1 assembly at the endosomes was highly dynamic, forming one or multiple domains at a time.
claims.source: Snx1 assembly at the endosomes was highly dynamic, forming one or multiple domains at a time (Figure 6—figure supplement 1 C).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on observations from time-lapse imaging.

claims.claim: Weak correlation of Snx1 and Rab5 localization in discrete domains on early endosomes was observed.
claims.source: We observed weak correlation of Snx1 and Rab5 localization in discrete domains on early endosomes (Figure 6D and E).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by correlation analysis of fluorescence intensity data.

claims.claim: Snx1 levels either declined during Rab conversion or persisted for a while.
claims.source: Moreover, Snx1 levels either declined during Rab conversion or persisted for a while.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on observations from individual endosome tracking.

claims.claim: Snx1 microdomains could either co-exist with or exist independently of Rab5.
claims.source: Our data indicate that Snx1 recruitment on early endosomes occurs simultaneously with Rab5, but that Snx1 microdomains could either co-exist with or exist independently of Rab5 (Cezanne et al., 2020; Gullapalli et al., 2004; Mari et al., 2008; Simonetti et al., 2017; Spang, 2021).
claims.evidence: This conclusion is based on imaging data and is consistent with previous research.

claims.claim: Although Rab5 may promote Snx1 recruitment, presumably through PI3P, it is not essential for its maintenance or dynamics at endosomes.
claims.source: This suggests that although Rab5 may promote Snx1 recruitment, presumably through PI3P (Zhong et al., 2005), it is not essential for its maintenance or dynamics at endosomes.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observed independence of Snx1 from Rab5 and is supported by a citation.

claims.claim: Snx1 recruitment peaked during early stages of Rab7 recruitment, when the endosome is expected to be Rab5-positive.
claims.source: Consistent with Snx1 presence during the Rab5 phase, Snx1 recruitment peaked during early stages of Rab7 recruitment, when the endosome is expected to be Rab5-positive (Figure 7B–D).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of fluorescence intensity data.

claims.claim: In about one third of all Rab7-positive endosomes analysed, Snx1 recruitment was transient and was no longer present after Rab7 peaked or levelled off.
claims.source: In about one third of all Rab7-positive endosomes analysed, Snx1 recruitment was transient and was no longer present after Rab7 peaked or levelled off to indicate completed Rab conversion (Figure 7B and E).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of multiple endosomes.

claims.claim: In another third of analysed endosomes, Snx1 initially displayed the same kinetics, but was recruited back again to the late Rab7-positive endosome.
claims.source: In another third of analysed endosomes, Snx1 initially displayed the same kinetics, but was recruited back again to the late Rab7-positive endosome (Figure 7C and F), suggesting that Rab5 may be dispensable for Snx1 recruitment to late endosomes.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of multiple endosomes and includes an inference about Rab5 dispensability.

claims.claim: In the remaining subset of endosomes, Snx1 peaked and persisted throughout endosome maturation.
claims.source: In the remaining subset of endosomes, Snx1 peaked and persisted throughout endosome maturation (Figure 7D and G).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of multiple endosomes.

claims.claim: Analysis of Rab7 and Snx1 domains at the endosome revealed weak correlation.
claims.source: Analysis of Rab7 and Snx1 domains at the endosome again revealed weak correlation of Rab7 and Snx1 domains (Figure 6—figure supplement 1D and E).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by correlation analysis of fluorescence intensity data.

claims.claim: Sorting into recycling pathways is most likely initiated very early on endosomes but can also persist on late endosomes, indicating a continuous process independent of Rab conversion.
claims.source: Taken together, our data suggest that sorting into recycling pathways is most likely initiated very early on endosomes but can also persist on late endosomes, indicating a continuous process independent of Rab conversion.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed Snx1 recruitment patterns.

claims.claim: Rab11-positive vesicles contacted early endosomes even before strong Rab5 recruitment.
claims.source: Surprisingly, Rab11-positive vesicles contacted early endosomes even before strong Rab5 recruitment (Figure 8A–C; Figure 8—video 1; Figure 8—video 2).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on time-lapse imaging observations.

claims.claim: Rab11 vesicles also contacted Rab5-positive endosomes.
claims.source: Rab11 vesicles also contacted Rab5-positive endosomes.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on imaging observations.

claims.claim: Contact between Rab11 vesicles and enlarged endosomes was not incidental because Rab11 vesicles probed and sometimes circled around the enlarged endosomes for various times.
claims.source: This contact between Rab11 vesicles and enlarged endosomes was not incidental because Rab11 vesicles probed and sometimes circled around the enlarged endosomes for various times before, during, and after Rab5 recruitment (Figure 8A, Figure 8—videos 2 and 3), almost reminiscent to the kiss-and-run of Rab11 endosomes on sorting endosomes (Solinger et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on detailed observations from time-lapse imaging and is compared to previously described behavior.

claims.claim: The Rab11 domains on Rab5 endosomes appeared to be independent of each other.
claims.source: The Rab11 domains on Rab5 endosomes appeared to be independent of each other (Figure 8D; Figure 8—figure supplement 1A and B).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on analysis of fluorescence intensity along the endosome rim.

claims.claim: Rab11 interaction with endosomes appeared not only to be independent of Rab5 but also of Rab7, or Rab conversion as it continued throughout endosome maturation.
claims.source: Moreover, Rab11 interaction with endosomes appeared not only to be independent of Rab5 but also of Rab7, or Rab conversion as it continued throughout endosome maturation (Figure 8E–H; Figure 8—video 4; Figure 8—figure supplement 1C).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on time-lapse imaging data showing Rab11 interactions throughout maturation.

claims.claim: Rab11 recruitment to endosomes appears to be largely decoupled from Rab conversion.
claims.source: Thus, our data indicate that, similar to sorting, Rab11 recruitment to endosomes appears to be largely decoupled from Rab conversion.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed Rab11 recruitment patterns.

claims.claim: All three cargoes (TfR-GFP, GFP-CDMPR, and GalT-GFP) were observed on Rab5-positive endosomes.
claims.source: All three cargoes were observed on Rab5-positive endosomes (Figure 9; Figure 9—figure supplement 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on imaging observations.

claims.claim: While the levels of the recycling cargoes TfR-GFP and GFP-CDMPR promptly decreased at the maturing enlarged endosomes, GalT-GFP levels remained almost constant.
claims.source: While the levels of the recycling cargoes TfR-GFP and GFP-CDMPR promptly decreased at the maturing enlarged endosomes, GalT-GFP levels remained almost constant (Figure 9; Figure 9—videos 1–3).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of fluorescence intensity data.

claims.claim: The GalT-GFP kinetics are very distinct to that of CDMPR, which is removed from the endosomes shortly before or during Rab5 recruitment.
claims.source: We cannot exclude that some of the GalT-GFP is recycled to the TGN and that some GalT-GFP arrives from the TGN to the enlarged endosomes. Nevertheless, the GalT-GFP kinetics are very distinct to that of CDMPR, which is removed from the endosomes shortly before or during Rab5 recruitment (Figure 9E and H).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on comparison of cargo kinetics.

claims.claim: CDMPR recruitment to the enlarged endosomes was observed, suggesting that both retrograde and anterograde pathways are functional in these endosomes.
claims.source: Additionally, we also observed CDMPR recruitment to the enlarged endosomes, suggesting that both retrograde and anterograde pathways are functional in these endosomes (Figure 9—figure supplement 1).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observation of CDMPR recruitment.

claims.claim: TfR kinetics revealed transient TfR acquisition at the enlarged Rab5-positive endosomes, reflecting that the majority of TfR arrives to the endosome from the plasma membrane.
claims.source: Of note, TfR kinetics were unique in revealing the transient TfR acquisition at the enlarged Rab5-positive endosomes, reflecting the observations that the majority of TfR arrives to the endosome from the plasma membrane (Figure 3—figure supplement 2).
claims.evidence: This is an interpretation of the observed TfR kinetics based on known TfR trafficking.

claims.claim: TfR is removed, and presumably recycled back to the plasma membrane, from the endosome at the time of Rab conversion.
claims.source: This is followed by removal, and presumed recycling back to the plasma membrane, of the TfR from the endosome at the time of Rab conversion (Figure 9D and G).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observed TfR kinetics and known TfR recycling.

claims.claim: The unique patterns of the three cargoes at the enlarged endosomes indicate that it might be possible to probe distinct cargo transport properties with this assay.
claims.source: The unique patterns of the three cargoes at the enlarged endosomes indicate that it might be possible to probe distinct cargo transport properties with our assay.
claims.evidence: This is a speculative statement about the potential applications of the assay.

claims.claim: The enlarged endosomes are capable of receiving cargo from the plasma membrane and the TGN and can promptly remove it for recycling back to their respective origins.
claims.source: Taken together, our data provide strong evidence that the enlarged endosomes are capable of receiving cargo from the plasma membrane and the TGN and can promptly remove it for recycling back to their respective origins.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed cargo trafficking patterns.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon is present at the Golgi-ribbon structures and in cytosolic CFP puncta representing highly acidified organelles in untreated cells.
claims.source: Untreated cells expressing the GalT-pHlemon sensor displayed a characteristic Golgi-ribbon appearance in both YFP and CFP channels as well as punctate appearance of CFP signal alone, indicative of highly acidified lysosomes or endolysosomes (Figure 10A).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on imaging observations of the pH sensor.

claims.claim: When signal was detected only in the CFP but not in the YFP channel, those structures were mostly positive for lysotracker.
claims.source: To confirm the identity of the CFP puncta, we labelled GalT-pHlemon expressing cells with lysotracker. When we detected signal only in the CFP but not in the YFP channel, those structures were mostly positive for lysotracker (Figure 10B).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by co-localization data with lysotracker.

claims.claim: A fraction of GalT-pHlemon might enter the endosomal degradation pathway even under normal growth conditions.
claims.source: Thus, a fraction of GalT-pHlemon might enter the endosomal degradation pathway even under normal growth conditions.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observation of GalT-pHlemon in acidified compartments.

claims.claim: GalT-pHemon was occasionally observed in Rab5-positive endosomes, suggesting transient GalT-pHlemon trafficking through early endosomes to lysotracker-positive endolysosomes and lysosomes.
claims.source: Indeed, in mApple-Rab5-expressing cells, we occasionally observed GalT-pHemon in Rab5-positive endosomes, suggesting the transient GalT-pHlemon trafficking through early endosomes to lysotracker-positive endolysosomes and lysosomes (Figure 10C).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observation of GalT-pHlemon in Rab5-positive endosomes.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon can reliably detect YFP/CFP ratios over the pH 4.0–7.5 range.
claims.source: We could reliably detect YFP/CFP ratios over the pH 4.0–7.5 range (Figure 10D, Figure 10—figure supplement 1A), allowing for accurate pH measurements of the entire endolysosomal pathway.
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by pH calibration experiments.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon designated pH 6.2 for the Golgi-ribbon structures and pH 4.0–5.7 for the lysosomes and endolysosomes in untreated cells.
claims.source: Our sensor designated pH 6.2 for the Golgi-ribbon structures and pH 4.0–5.7 for the lysosomes and endolysosomes, as detected by the CFP puncta, in untreated cells (Figure 10E).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on pH measurements using the calibrated sensor.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon located to the nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes and indicated a pH range between 5.5 and 6.6 at 50 min washout.
claims.source: Most importantly, our sensor located to the nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes and indicated a pH range between 5.5 and 6.6 at 50 min washout, reflective of the different stages of maturation (Figure 10E and F, Figure 10—video 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on pH measurements in enlarged endosomes.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon is a useful tool to read-out pH in the endosomal system.
claims.source: Therefore, GalT-pHlemon is a useful tool to read-out pH in the endosomal system.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the demonstrated pH-sensing capabilities of the sensor.

claims.claim: The enlarged endosomes undergo fusion with lysosomes, as visualized by CFP puncta circling around the enlarged endosome and passing the entire CFP content to it.
claims.source: The enlarged endosomes indeed undergo fusion with lysosomes, as visualized by the CFP puncta circling around the enlarged endosome and passing the entire CFP content to it (Figure 10—figure supplement 1B; Figure 10—video 2).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on time-lapse imaging observations.

claims.claim: The resulting endolysosomes shrink over time and increase in CFP signal intensity as they are anticipated to regenerate the lysosome.
claims.source: The resulting endolysosomes shrink over time and increase in CFP signal intensity as they are anticipated to regenerate the lysosome.
claims.evidence: This is an interpretation of the observed morphological changes and signal intensity changes.

claims.claim: GalT-pHlemon sensor is particularly useful for illuminating the entire endolysosomal pathway and monitoring its pH.
claims.source: This makes the GalT-pHlemon sensor particularly useful for illuminating the entire endolysosomal pathway and monitoring its pH.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion about the utility of the sensor based on its observed properties.

claims.claim: The nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes showed a dramatic decrease in YFP signal, which always coincided with Rab5-positive stages of endosome maturation.
claims.source: The nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes showed a dramatic decrease in YFP signal, which always coincided with Rab5-positive stages of endosome maturation (Figure 11A–C, Figure 11—video 1) and with early phases of Rab7 recruitment (Figure 11D–F, Figure 11—video 2).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on time-lapse imaging observations of the pH sensor.

claims.claim: Ratiometric quantifications revealed relatively stable YFP/CFP ratio prior to Rab5 recruitment, followed by a sharp decrease during Rab5 recruitment and Rab conversion, and stabilisation of a new, lower YFP/CFP ratio in Rab7-positive endosomes.
claims.source: Ratiometric quantifications of intraluminal YFP and CFP signals revealed relatively stable YFP/CFP ratio prior to Rab5 recruitment, followed by a sharp decrease during Rab5 recruitment and Rab conversion, and stabilisation of a new, lower YFP/CFP ratio in Rab7-positive endosomes (Figure 11B, C, E and F).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on quantitative analysis of pH sensor data.

claims.claim: Conversion of YFP/CFP ratios to pH values indicates an average pH of 6.6 in early endosomes prior to Rab5 recruitment and a final pH of 5.7 in Rab7 endosomes.
claims.source: Conversion of YFP/CFP ratios to pH values indicates an average pH of 6.6 in early endosomes prior to Rab5 recruitment and a final pH of 5.7 in Rab7 endosomes.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on conversion of ratiometric data to pH values using calibration curves.

claims.claim: The biggest pH drop occurs concomitantly with the recruitment of Rab7, pointing to a regulation of acidification during endosome maturation.
claims.source: Our data indicate that the biggest pH drop occurs concomitantly with the recruitment of Rab7, pointing to a regulation of acidification during endosome maturation.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed timing of pH changes relative to Rab7 recruitment.

claims.claim: Ccz1 depletion abolished Rab7 recruitment to, and Rab5 removal from, the nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes.
claims.source: Ccz1 depletion abolished Rab7 recruitment to, and Rab5 removal from, the nigericin-induced enlarged endosomes (Figure 12A, Figure 12—videos 1–3).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by imaging data from Ccz1 knockout cells.

claims.claim: Ccz1-deficient Rab5-positive endosomes could engage in homotypic fusion and interact with Rab5-positive enlarged compartments but did not mature to classical endolysosomes.
claims.source: Ccz1-deficient Rab5-positive endosomes could engage in homotypic fusion and interact with Rab5-positive enlarged compartments but did not mature to classical endolysosomes (Figure 12—figure supplement 1B; Figure 1C; Figure 12A).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on imaging observations in Ccz1 knockout cells.

claims.claim: Perturbations in Ccz1 knockout cells could be efficiently rescued by expression of wild-type Ccz1.
claims.source: These perturbations could be efficiently rescued by expression of wild-type Ccz1 in Ccz1 knock-out cell lines (Figure 12A; Figure 12—videos 1–3).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by rescue experiments showing restoration of normal phenotype.

claims.claim: In Ccz1 KO cells, acidification was strongly delayed compared to control and Ccz1 rescue cells.
claims.source: While in the control and Ccz1 rescue cells, acidification occurred with similar kinetics as observed above (Figure 11B and C), in Ccz1 KO cells the acidification was strongly delayed (Figure 12B–D).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by quantitative analysis of pH sensor data in different cell lines.

claims.claim: Acidification occurred eventually after a long delay in Ccz1 KO cells.
claims.source: Nevertheless, acidification occurred eventually after a long delay in Ccz1 KO cells.
claims.evidence: This claim is based on observations of pH changes over extended time periods.

claims.claim: Ccz1 KO cells have grossly enlarged CFP-filled puncta and compartments, reflective of their enlarged lysosomes and acidified hybrid compartments.
claims.source: In line with this conclusion, Ccz1 KO cells have grossly enlarged CFP-filled puncta and compartments, reflective of their enlarged lysosomes and acidified hybrid compartments as also observed with Lysotracker staining of Rab5-positive compartments (Figure 13A; Figure 13—figure supplement 1).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on imaging observations in Ccz1 knockout cells.

claims.claim: The CFP-positive compartments in untreated cells showed no differences in pH between Ccz1-replete and Ccz1-deficient cells, ranging from pH 5.7 to pH 4.0.
claims.source: The CFP-positive compartments in untreated cells showed no differences in pH between Ccz1-replete and Ccz1-deficient cells, ranging from pH 5.7 to pH 4.0, indicative of endolysosomes and lysosomes, respectively (Figure 13A and B).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on pH measurements in untreated cells.

claims.claim: Following disruption of pH by nigericin treatment and washout, wild-type cells restored their lysosomal pH, while Ccz1 KO cells displayed a wide range of pH in pHlemon-filled compartments.
claims.source: Furthermore, following disruption of pH by nigericin treatment and washout, wild-type cells restored their lysosomal pH, while Ccz1 KO cells displayed a wide range of pH in pHlemon-filled compartments, ranging from pH 6.4 to pH 4.0 (Figure 13C and D).
claims.evidence: This claim is based on pH measurements after nigericin treatment in different cell lines.

claims.claim: Rab conversion is driving efficient endosomal acidification.
claims.source: Taken together, our data suggest that Rab conversion is driving efficient endosomal acidification.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed delay in acidification when Rab conversion is blocked.

claims.claim: The assay faithfully recapitulates endosome maturation as described in other model systems.
claims.source: Thus, our assay faithfully recapitulates endosome maturation as described in other model systems.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on comparison of the assay results with published data.

claims.claim: At least a fraction of the swollen TGN will be shed into the endosomal system as a part of the stress response and to attain homeostasis.
claims.source: We assume that at least a fraction of the swollen TGN will be shed into the endosomal system as a part of the stress response and to attain homeostasis.
claims.evidence: This is a speculative interpretation of the observed TGN swelling.

claims.claim: The shed TGN membranes can fuse with Rab5 endocytic structures and then acquire early endosomal identity.
claims.source: We surmise that the shed TGN membranes can fuse with Rab5 endocytic structures and then acquire early endosomal identity.
claims.evidence: This is a speculative mechanism based on observed interactions between TGN-derived membranes and Rab5 endosomes.

claims.claim: Recycling from the endosome can happen throughout the lifetime of an endosome, as reflected by the presence of Snx1 and Rab11 vesicles at the maturing endosome.
claims.source: Our data suggest that recycling from the endosome can happen throughout the lifetime of an endosome, as reflected by the presence of Snx1 and Rab11 vesicles at the maturing endosome.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed recruitment patterns of Snx1 and Rab11.

claims.claim: Snx1 was recruited simultaneously with Rab5 probably mediated through its PX domain.
claims.source: We observed that Snx1 was recruited simultaneously with Rab5 probably mediated through its PX domain (Peter et al., 2004), consistent with the reported coordination between the two proteins (van Weering et al., 2012).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observed co-recruitment and known properties of Snx1, supported by citations.

claims.claim: The PX domain recognises PI(3)P, which is recruited concomitantly with Rab5 to maturing endosomes.
claims.source: The PX domain recognises PI(3)P, which is recruited concomitantly with Rab5 to maturing endosomes.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about the PX domain and is consistent with the observed co-recruitment.

claims.claim: The onset of recycling is coordinated with the arrival of Rab5, at least for Snx1, but the process itself is independent of Rab conversion.
claims.source: Therefore, our data suggest that the onset of recycling is coordinated with the arrival of Rab5, at least for Snx1, but the process itself is independent of Rab conversion, as previously suggested (Rojas et al., 2008).
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on the observed Snx1 recruitment patterns and is consistent with previous research.

claims.claim: When Rab conversion is blocked, Rab11 localization and Rab11-dependent recycling are not affected in C. elegans oocytes.
claims.source: Consistently, we have shown previously that when Rab conversion is blocked, Rab11 localization and Rab11-dependent recycling are not affected in C. elegans oocytes (Poteryaev et al., 2010; Poteryaev et al., 2007).
claims.evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous research by the authors.

claims.claim: Rab conversion is required for efficient acidification.
claims.source: With this new probe, we showed that Rab conversion is required for efficient acidification.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion based on experiments using the pH sensor in Ccz1 knockout cells.

claims.claim: Over extended times, acidification of endosomes still occurred in absence of Rab conversion.
claims.source: Over extended times, acidification of endosomes still occurred in absence of Rab conversion and we speculate that this acidification can help drive fusion with lysosomes.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from Ccz1 knockout cells with a speculative interpretation.

claims.claim: The delayed acidification in absence of Rab conversion may explain why a sand-1 mutant in C. elegans, knockdown of Mon1a and b, or a Ccz1 KO in mammalian cells is not lethal.
claims.source: Moreover, this effect may explain why a sand-1 mutant in C. elegans, knockdown of Mon1a and b, or a Ccz1 KO in mammalian cells is not lethal (Poteryaev et al., 2010; Poteryaev et al., 2007).

results.result: Acute ionophore treatment (nigericin, monensin, or NH4Cl) induces enlarged endosomal compartments that undergo Rab5-to-Rab7 conversion and mature into late endosomes and endolysosomes. This phenomenon is observed across multiple cell lines (HeLa, HEK293, COS1, Neuro2A) and is reversible, with cells recovering normal morphology within 20-48 hours.
results.evaluation: Claims C14-C29 provide extensive microscopy evidence showing enlarged Rab5/Rab7-positive endosomes after ionophore treatment, with time-lapse imaging demonstrating Rab conversion kinetics consistent with previous literature (C18, C46, C47). Multiple ionophores produce similar effects (C26), and the phenomenon is reproducible across cell lines (C28). Cell viability data (C36, C37) confirm minimal toxicity. The evidence is internally consistent and well-documented with imaging data.

results.result: The enlarged endosomal compartments originate from swollen trans-Golgi network (TGN) membranes that are shed into the endosomal pathway following ionophore treatment. GalT-positive TGN membranes acquire Rab5, undergo Rab conversion, and mature into late endosomes, with the Golgi recovering normal morphology within 48 hours.
results.evaluation: Electron microscopy (C30, C32) and fluorescence imaging (C38-C41) demonstrate TGN swelling and GalT presence in enlarged endosomes and ILVs. Time-lapse imaging shows Golgi vesiculation and Rab5 acquisition (C39, C40). Autophagy is ruled out as a contributor (C31). The transient nature of TGN swelling with recovery by 48 hours (C34) and occasional observation in untreated cells (C35) support a stress-induced amplification of a natural process. The evidence converges from multiple imaging modalities.

results.result: Enlarged endosomes can acquire endocytic cargo (Dextran, transferrin receptor) from the plasma membrane, and this cargo is retained as endosomes undergo Rab conversion and mature to endolysosomes.
results.evaluation: Claims C42-C44 demonstrate cargo uptake using Dextran pulse-chase and TfR labeling with nanobodies. Time-lapse imaging shows Dextran-positive endosomes undergoing Rab conversion (C43) and TfR reaching Rab5-positive enlarged endosomes (C44). The experiments use appropriate controls and multiple cargo types, providing convergent evidence that enlarged endosomes are functionally competent for cargo uptake.

results.result: Rab5-to-Rab7 conversion on enlarged endosomes occurs with kinetics similar to previously reported observations: conversion completes within ~4 minutes, Rab5 drops when Rab7 reaches ~50% of maximum, and Rab7 plateaus after Rab5 removal. Occasionally, multiple Rab5 peaks are observed.
results.evaluation: Quantitative analysis of time-lapse imaging (C46-C48) shows conversion kinetics consistent with multiple prior studies (Del Conte-Zerial 2008, Poteryaev 2010, Rink 2005). The 4-minute conversion time and 50% Rab7 threshold for Rab5 removal match published data. Multiple Rab5 peaks (C49) are documented but interpreted speculatively (C50). The core kinetic measurements are well-supported by quantitative data from ≥27 endosomes.

results.result: PI(3)P (detected by GFP-FYVE) appears concomitantly with Rab5 on enlarged early endosomes, with a slight delay in PI(3)P disappearance after Rab5 peaks, indicating tight temporal and spatial regulation of PI(3)P during endosome maturation.
results.evaluation: Time-lapse imaging with GFP-FYVE (C51) shows co-recruitment with Rab5, consistent with the known Rab5-PI(3)P positive feedback loop. Quantitative analysis (C52) reveals a delay in PI(3)P turnover after Rab5 peaks, supported by data from 19 endosomes. This is consistent with models where PI(3)P persistence may facilitate Rab7 GEF recruitment. The interpretation of tight regulation (C53) is reasonable given the observed kinetics.

results.result: Snx1 recruitment to endosomes occurs concomitantly with Rab5 but persists throughout endosome maturation in a manner largely independent of Rab conversion. Snx1 forms dynamic microdomains that can co-exist with or exist independently of Rab5/Rab7, with weak spatial correlation between Snx1 and Rab proteins.
results.evaluation: Time-lapse imaging (C56-C66) demonstrates Snx1 recruitment patterns across multiple endosomes, showing three distinct behaviors: transient (1/3), biphasic (1/3), and persistent (1/3) recruitment relative to Rab7 (C63-C65). Correlation analysis shows weak spatial correlation (r=0.43) between Snx1 and Rab5/Rab7 (C58, C66). The data support the conclusion that sorting is uncoupled from Rab conversion (C67), consistent with cited literature. Sample sizes (12-21 endosomes per condition) are adequate for the observed variability.

results.result: Rab11-positive recycling endosomes contact and interact with maturing endosomes throughout the maturation process, independent of Rab5 or Rab7 status. Rab11 vesicles probe and circle around enlarged endosomes in a non-incidental manner, with Rab11 domains appearing independent of each other.
results.evaluation: Time-lapse imaging (C68-C72) shows Rab11 vesicles contacting endosomes before, during, and after Rab5 recruitment, with dynamic probing behavior. Correlation analysis shows weak correlation (r=0.28) between Rab11 and Rab5 (Figure 8—figure supplement 1B). The data from 14-16 endosomes support the conclusion that Rab11 recruitment is decoupled from Rab conversion (C73), consistent with prior work in C. elegans (C113).

results.result: Enlarged endosomes selectively recycle cargo: TfR and CDMPR are promptly removed from maturing endosomes, while GalT persists. TfR shows transient acquisition reflecting plasma membrane origin, while CDMPR removal occurs before/during Rab5 recruitment. The enlarged endosomes are capable of receiving and recycling cargo from both plasma membrane and TGN.
results.evaluation: Time-lapse imaging with three different cargoes (C74-C79) shows distinct kinetic patterns consistent with their known trafficking routes. TfR shows transient acquisition and removal during Rab conversion (C78-C79), CDMPR is removed early (C76), and GalT persists (C75-C76). CDMPR recruitment is also observed (C77), indicating bidirectional trafficking. The data from 17-24 endosomes per cargo support functional competence for cargo sorting (C81). The speculative statement about probing distinct cargo properties (C80) is appropriately qualified.

results.result: GalT-pHlemon is a functional pH sensor that localizes to the Golgi and enters the endolysosomal pathway, reliably detecting pH over the range 4.0-7.5. The sensor designates pH 6.2 for Golgi, pH 4.0-5.7 for lysosomes/endolysosomes, and pH 5.5-6.6 for enlarged endosomes at 50 min post-nigericin treatment.
results.evaluation: The pH sensor is validated by calibration experiments (C86) showing reliable detection over pH 4.0-7.5. Co-localization with lysotracker (C83) confirms identity of acidified compartments. pH measurements in untreated cells (C87) and enlarged endosomes (C88) are consistent with known endosomal pH values. The sensor localizes to the entire endolysosomal pathway (C82-C85, C90-C91) and provides ratiometric measurements suitable for pH determination (C89, C92). The calibration and validation are appropriate.

results.result: Efficient endosomal acidification is dependent on Rab conversion. The biggest pH drop (from ~6.6 to ~5.7) occurs concomitantly with Rab7 recruitment. Ccz1 knockout blocks Rab conversion and strongly delays acidification, though acidification eventually occurs after extended time. Ccz1 knockout cells have enlarged acidified hybrid compartments but can restore lysosomal pH after nigericin treatment.
results.evaluation: Time-lapse pH imaging (C93-C96) shows sharp pH decrease during Rab5 recruitment and Rab conversion, with quantitative data from 18-19 endosomes. Ccz1 knockout experiments (C97-C105) demonstrate that blocking Rab conversion delays but does not prevent acidification, with data from 54-56 endosomes across three independent experiments using different clones. Rescue experiments (C99) confirm specificity. pH measurements in untreated and treated cells (C103-C104) show that Ccz1 KO affects acidification kinetics but not final lysosomal pH. The conclusion that Rab conversion drives efficient acidification (C105, C114) is well-supported.

results.result: The nigericin-induced enlarged endosome assay faithfully recapitulates endosome maturation as described in other model systems, is accessible to most cell biology laboratories using standard widefield microscopy, and is a powerful tool for studying endosome biology.
results.evaluation: The assay reproduces key features of endosome maturation: Rab conversion kinetics match published data (C46-C47, C106), PI(3)P dynamics are consistent with known feedback loops (C51-C53), and the system is applicable across multiple cell lines (C28-C29). The assay requires only standard widefield microscopy (C2) and produces results consistent with literature across multiple parameters. The claims about accessibility (C119) and utility (C120) are supported by the demonstrated applications throughout the manuscript.

results.result: The authors speculate that swollen TGN membranes are shed into the endosomal system as part of a stress response to attain homeostasis, and that these membranes can fuse with Rab5 endocytic structures to acquire early endosomal identity.
results.evaluation: These are explicitly speculative interpretations (C107-C108) of the observed TGN swelling and subsequent endosome formation. While the observations of TGN swelling (C30) and GalT presence in endosomes (C32, C40) are well-documented, the mechanism of membrane shedding and fusion is inferred rather than directly demonstrated. The speculation is reasonable given the data but lacks direct evidence of the proposed shedding and fusion events.

results.result: The onset of recycling is coordinated with Rab5 arrival (at least for Snx1, likely through PI(3)P recognition by the PX domain), but the recycling process itself is independent of Rab conversion. This is consistent with previous observations in C. elegans showing that Rab11 localization and recycling are unaffected when Rab conversion is blocked.
results.evaluation: The conclusion (C109, C112) is supported by the observed Snx1 and Rab11 recruitment patterns (C56-C73) showing persistence throughout maturation. The mechanistic interpretation involving the PX domain and PI(3)P (C110-C111) is reasonable given known Snx1 properties and is supported by citations. The consistency with C. elegans data (C113) strengthens the conclusion. The inference is well-supported by the current data and prior literature.

results.result: Acidification of endosomes still occurs in the absence of Rab conversion after extended times, which may explain why mutations blocking Rab conversion (sand-1 in C. elegans, Mon1a/b knockdown, Ccz1 KO in mammalian cells) are not lethal.
results.evaluation: The observation of delayed acidification in Ccz1 KO cells (C100-C101) is well-documented. The speculation about why Rab conversion mutants are viable (C116) is reasonable and supported by citations to prior work showing non-lethality of these mutations. While the causal link is inferred rather than directly tested, the logic is sound and the observation provides a plausible explanation for published phenotypes.

results.result: The authors speculate that V-ATPase activity may be upregulated during Rab conversion, possibly driven by Rab7 effectors like RILP, or through phosphorylation/dephosphorylation of V-ATPase subunits, though the specific regulators remain unidentified.
results.evaluation: These are explicitly speculative mechanisms (C117-C118) for how Rab conversion might regulate acidification. While the speculation is informed by citations to RILP literature (C117), no direct evidence for V-ATPase regulation is provided in the current study. These represent reasonable hypotheses for future investigation but are not supported by data in this manuscript.

results.result: Background claims about endosome biology: endosomes orchestrate cell-environment interactions, undergo sorting, are characterized by selective Rab5/Rab7 recruitment, contain PI(3)P that is phosphorylated to PI(3,5)P2, undergo acidification (pH ~6.5, 5.5, 4.5 for early/late endosomes/lysosomes), and are difficult to track due to small size and rapid movement. Phagosomes provide a specialized but limited model for endosome maturation. Nigericin is a reversible ionophore for protons and K+ ions.
results.evaluation: These are established facts about endosome biology (C5-C10, C15) supported by citations to prior literature, or descriptions of technical challenges (C11) and limitations of existing models (C12-C13). These claims provide necessary context and are appropriately supported by citations or represent consensus knowledge in the field.

results.result: Multiple Rab5 peaks may indicate the reversible nature of endosome maturation and existence of checkpoints to ensure alignment of parallel processes.
results.evaluation: This is a speculative interpretation (C50) of the observed multiple Rab5 peaks (C49). While the observation is documented, the mechanistic interpretation about reversibility and checkpoints is not directly tested. The speculation is reasonable but lacks supporting evidence beyond the kinetic observations.

results.result: The unique patterns of the three cargoes at enlarged endosomes indicate that it might be possible to probe distinct cargo transport properties with this assay.
results.evaluation: This is a modest, appropriately qualified speculation (C80) about potential applications of the assay. The observation of distinct cargo kinetics (C74-C79) supports the possibility of using the assay to study cargo-specific trafficking. The claim is appropriately tentative and supported by the demonstrated cargo experiments.
